ActorGenericId.description: This parameter filters events based on associated camera IDs for the specified actors.  The actor type is prefixed along with the actor ID in the format `actorType:actorId`. Supported actor types: - `camera` (e.g. `camera:100d4c41`) - `location` (e.g. `location:d0e4aad4-06c5-4c43-a4ac-3106738ed206`) - `bridge` (e.g. `bridge:10035b4a`)
